parts.stem: Order the steps of an experiment performed to test the effect of temperature on the rate of dissolving a solute in a solvent.

items.value: Record the time needed to dissolve sugar in each case.
Fill two beakers with the same amount of water.
Heat beaker B and leave beaker A without heating.
Put two equal amounts of sugar in the two beakers and label them A and B.

correct_answer: Fill two beakers with the same amount of water.
Put two equal amounts of sugar in the two beakers and label them A and B.
Heat beaker B and leave beaker A without heating.
Record the time needed to dissolve sugar in each case.
